clean_description: Convenience Store Woman follows Keiko Furukura, a 36-year-old woman who finds her place in the world working at a convenience store in Tokyo. Despite her contentment in this role, societal pressures from her family and peers push her to conform to traditional expectations of marriage and career. The novel explores themes of individuality, societal norms, and the complexities of modern work culture through Keiko's unique perspective.
